description: Patch instant alert-rule conditions with version/hash guards and seeded before/after tests. Compatibility alias for condition-level tuning.

applyGlobally.description: Required true for system rules. Updates every customer copy of the system rule.

conditions.description: Optional full replacement instant conditions array. Use operations for smaller patches.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

executionMode.description: Rule execution mode: instant or hybrid when instant detection is enabled.

expectedCurrentInstantHash.description: Required SHA-256 hash of the current instant config from securenow_alert_rule_conditions_get.

expectedCurrentRuleHash.description: Optional SHA-256 hash of the current instant/throttle/severity surface from securenow_alert_rule_conditions_get.

fixtures.description: Optional seeded fixtures. Each may include kind attack/benign, label, path, method, requestBody, requestHeaders, and expectMatch.

matchMode.description: Condition match mode: all or any.

operations.description: Condition patch operations: add_condition, remove_condition, update_condition. Use zero-based index/conditionIndex for remove/update.

reactivatePausedCopies.description: Whether to reactivate paused noisy copies after the condition is tuned.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

reviewNote.description: Optional review note. Defaults to reason.

reviewNotificationId.description: Optional notification id tied to this review/tuning action.

name: securenow_alert_rule_condition_update
title: Update Alert Rule Condition
